how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From order to reward in four steps.

step1.title: Pick a location
step1.description: Choose your city and a location on the map. You'll see the menu, opening hours and whether it offers pickup or delivery.

step2.title: Order or show your card
step2.description: Order in the app for pickup or delivery. Buying in person? Show your Loodly card at the counter.

step3.title: Collect points
step3.description: You earn points for app orders and for purchases at the counter — they go straight to your card.

step4.title: Get your reward
step4.description: Once you have enough points, swap them for a reward in the app or at the counter.

loyalty.title: One card everywhere
loyalty.lead: Like the old stamp card — except you can't lose it. It's on your phone, and you show it at every location on Loodly.
loyalty.r1_title: Points stay where you earn them
loyalty.r1_body: Every logo in the app has its own balance. Spend the points at any location under the same name — around the corner or in another city.
loyalty.r2_body: Pick whichever you prefer — staff scan it at the counter. One tap makes the code bigger and your screen brighter.
loyalty.r3_body: Like double points on Thursdays from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. There can also be points on your birthday and for inviting a friend — you'll see it all in the app.
loyalty.mock_alt: Example app screen: a card with a code and three separate points balances.

rewards.title: What can you get for your points?
rewards.subtitle: A few examples, from a coffee and a croissant to an umbrella with a logo. Every rewards catalog is different — you'll find the current rewards and their prices in points in the app.
rewards.note: Merch is shown with the Loodly logo — these are just examples.

features.title: Why Loodly?
features.subtitle: Everything you need to shop local, the easy way.

pickup.title: Pickup at the location
pickup.description: Order ahead in the app and pick it up when it's ready. Show your card at pickup and the points land in your account.

delivery.title: Delivery you can follow on the map
delivery.description: Where a location delivers, order to your door and watch your courier on the map.

pay.title: Pay your way
pay.description: Online — by card, BLIK, Apple Pay or Google Pay — or in person at pickup, where the location allows it.

menu.title: Up-to-date menus
menu.description: Prices, descriptions and allergens, all together. When something sells out, staff mark it right away.

map.title: Locations on the map
map.description: Pick your city and see what's open now, where you can get delivery and where to pick up.

news.title: News and offers
news.description: Updates and offers from the locations you like, all together in the app.

app.title: It's all in the Loodly app
app.subtitle: Menus, orders, your card and rewards — always at hand.
